intro.title: transform-origin
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple interactive demo that rotates a square element to see how the point of rotation changes. You will learn the core concept of transform-origin, which controls the fixed point (like the center, corner, or edge) around which CSS transforms like rotation or scaling occur. The main technology involved is CSS, using the transform-origin property along with transform: rotate. By adjusting the transform-origin values, you'll visually explore how changing the origin point affects the element's movement, making your animations and transformations more precise and dynamic.
intro.usecase: The transform-origin property is essential for creating polished interactive UI elements in real-world applications. Developers use it to control rotation and scaling pivot points in dashboard widgets, such as rotating gauge needles around their base or expanding panels from specific corners. In modern interfaces, transform-origin enables realistic card flips in e-commerce product galleries, where cards rotate around their edges, and precise menu animations where dropdowns expand from their trigger points. This property is also crucial for creating loading spinners that rotate around their center and modal windows that scale up from their middle rather than awkwardly from a corner.
